classic.title: Character sheet forge
classic.intro: Build a Classic World of Darkness (Revised) sheet: place your creation dots, then spend 15 freebie points. Scroll the sheet in order, or jump with the nav. Your Storyteller has final say on numbers and templates.
classic.templateSub: Clan, breed, or tradition — your chronicle’s baseline
classic.areteHint: Arete starts at 1. You will assign six sphere dots in Advantages.
classic.natureSub: Classic oWoD-style archetypes (Revised-era lists). Pick Custom to type your own.
classic.archetypeExtra: Optional: extra detail, or wording for another system
classic.attributesSub: Every attribute starts at 1. Add 7 / 5 / 3 dots across Physical, Social, Mental.
classic.abilitiesSub: 13 / 9 / 5 across Talents, Skills, Knowledges; no ability above 3 before freebies. Custom rows share the column pools.
classic.advantagesSub: Line-specific pools — virtues, spheres, or Garou energy.
classic.kindredSub: 3 Discipline dots, 5 Background dots, Virtues 1 free each + 7. Humanity and Willpower follow from your Virtues.
classic.dotsAtCreation: ({{n}} dots at creation; more with freebies)
classic.virtuesPlacedBought: (1 free each + 7 = {{total}}; placed {{placed}} + {{bought}} bought with freebies; those don't change Humanity or Willpower)
classic.spheresSub: Allocate exactly 6 dots among the nine spheres (Arete remains 1).
classic.garouSub: Starting Rage, Gnosis, and gifts — set with your Storyteller.
classic.giftsPlaceholder: Gift names, rank, or table agreements…
classic.storySub: Background narrative and structured merits / flaws.
classic.freebiesSub: 15 points (+ up to 7 from Flaws) to raise anything above the creation budgets.

created: Character forged. Here is the chronicle: you can play right away.

freebies.help: Place your creation dots first. Freebie mode lifts the limits (abilities above 3, extra dots); anything beyond the creation budgets is priced here. Costs per dot: {{costs}}. Merits cost their points; Flaws give up to 7 more.

merits.intro: Named merits and flaws (points + for merits, − for flaws). Add rows as on a paper sheet.
merits.name: Name
merits.extraNotesPlaceholder: House rules, ST approval, page refs…

v5.created: Character embraced. Here is the chronicle: you can play right away.
v5.title: Character sheet forge · V5
v5.clanSub: Age sets the generation range and starting Blood Potency.
v5.attributesSub: One at 4, three at 3, four at 2, one at 1.
v5.skillsSub: Pick a distribution, then free specialties.
v5.specialtiesHelp: Specialties: {{n}} free (one each for rated Academics, Craft, Performance, Science, plus one of your choice). The predator type adds one more below.
v5.discCaitiff: Any two Disciplines: one at 2 dots, one at 1. One power per dot.
v5.discClan: Two clan Disciplines: one at 2 dots, one at 1. One power per dot.
v5.predatorSub: How you hunt: a specialty, one Discipline dot, and the type's extras.
v5.thinHelp: Thin-bloods also take {{lo}}–{{hi}} thin-blood Merits and the same number of thin-blood Flaws (core p. 182). They have no dot value and don't count toward the totals above. The rules file has no list of them, so write the names from the book.
v5.humanitySub: 1–3 Convictions, each with a mortal Touchstone.
v5.fledgling: Just-Embraced fledgling: start at Humanity {{n}} instead of {{base}} (Storyteller option)
v5.startingRitualPlaceholder: optional: one Level 1 Blood Sorcery ritual
v5.xpSub: Optional: {{total}} XP to spend now, one dot at a time. Attributes new × {{attr}}, Skills new × {{skill}}, a new specialty {{spec}}, clan Disciplines new × {{clan}}, other Disciplines new × {{other}} (Caitiff new × {{caitiff}}), rituals level × {{ritual}}. Unspent XP is kept.
v5.introV2: Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition creation, in the corebook's order: concept, clan, a fixed attribute spread, a skill distribution, 2 + 1 Discipline dots, a predator type, 7 Advantage dots and 2 Flaw dots of your own, Convictions, then age. No freebie points in V5.
v5.advantagesSubV2: Up to {{adv}} dots of Merits and Backgrounds (+ for advantages), at least {{flaws}} dots of Flaws of your own (− for flaws). The predator type's advantages and Flaws are extra, on top of these.
v5.ancillaBudgetHint: An ancilla (chosen in the Age step) gets {{adv}} more Advantage dots and takes {{flaws}} more Flaw dots.
v5.clanSubV2: Your clan sets your Disciplines, bane and compulsion.
v5.previewFlaws: Flaws: {{list}} (extra, on top of your own {{min}})
v5.predatorFlawsExtra: These Flaws are extra: you still take {{min}} dots of Flaws of your own in Advantages.
v5.predatorPreviewPickV2: Preview a predator type (this also sets it for the next step)
v5.startingCeremony: Starting Oblivion ceremony (Level 1, needs its prerequisite power)
v5.grantNoRating: the book prints no rating: ask your Storyteller
v5.ancillaOnly: Ancillae only (set the age in the Age step).
v5.advantagesSubCatalog: Up to {{adv}} dots of Backgrounds, Merits and loresheets, at least {{flaws}} dots of Flaws of your own. The predator type's advantages and Flaws are extra, on top of these.
v5.advCustomHint: Not in the catalog: your Storyteller has to approve it.
v5.noPositiveStatus: {{clan}} can't buy positive Status at creation.
v5.clanFlawV3: {{clan}} start with it (core p. 107). It counts toward your {{min}} Flaw dots.
v5.loreHelpV3: Loresheets are bought with Advantage dots like any other Advantage (core p. 151). Each level is its own benefit, costs its number in dots and does not include the lower ones (p. 190). This app lets you take more than one at creation, a house ruling: the corebook has each player choose a Loresheet, more in play if the Storyteller allows (p. 151).
v5.thinHelpCatalogV2: Thin-bloods also take {{lo}}–{{hi}} thin-blood Merits and the same number of thin-blood Flaws (core p. 182). They have no dot value and don't count toward the totals above. A few can't be taken together (p. 183).

v5.savedDots_other: {{count}} dots will be saved for later: spend them from your sheet, the Storyteller approves.

v5.savedDotsLost_other: This chronicle saves at most {{cap}}, so {{count}} unspent dots are lost.

ghoul.noDomitor: A ghoul belongs to one of your V5 vampires, and you have none yet. Forge the vampire first.
ghoul.created: {{name}} is Bound to {{domitor}}. The sheet is on your Profile.
ghoul.intro: A mortal fed on a vampire's Blood. Build them on a corebook mortal template, which is what the domitor's Retainers buy (core pp. 185, 194), or as a player ghoul (Players Guide pp. 140–142). One level-1 power of the domitor's Disciplines; no Hunger, no predator type.
ghoul.humanityPlayer: 1–3 Convictions, each with a Touchstone, as mortals take them (Players Guide p. 142).
ghoul.humanityRetainer: Optional for a retainer: up to 3 Convictions, each with a Touchstone.
ghoul.trackHumanity: Track Humanity (ghouls start at {{n}}, Players Guide p. 142)
ghoul.powerSub: A level-1 power of one of your domitor's Disciplines.
ghoul.powerNoDisciplines: The domitor's sheet lists no Disciplines: ask your Storyteller which power the Blood brought.
ghoul.domitorLacksIt: (the domitor doesn't have it: Storyteller's call, core p. 234)
ghoul.powerNote: It counts as one dot in {{discipline}} (Players Guide p. 141). No Rouse Checks: a power above level 1 costs 1 Aggravated instead (core p. 234). More level-1 powers of the domitor's Disciplines cost 10 XP each later.
ghoul.specialtiesPlayer: Specialties: {{n}} (one each for rated Academics, Craft, Performance, Science, plus one of your choice; Players Guide p. 141).
ghoul.specialtiesTemplate: Specialties: {{n}} here: the template's {{own}} on Skills with dots, plus one for each rated Academics, Craft, Performance and Science.
ghoul.lastFed: Last fed on the domitor's Blood
ghoul.feedingNote: Feeding note: how often, from whom, what it costs
ghoul.feedingRule: A Rouse Check's worth of the domitor's Blood keeps a ghoul for about a month (core p. 234); without it the years catch up fast. A V5 ghoul has no vitae track, Hunger or Blood Potency: this is a note, nothing is counted.

classicGhoul.disciplinesHint: (Potence 1 and one dot in another Discipline; up to {{cap}} for the ghoul of a generation {{gen}} domitor)
classicGhoul.vassalDisciplines: A vassal learns one of its domitor's Disciplines, or Celerity or Fortitude, which the Blood teaches by instinct. Protean and Thaumaturgy only from a Gangrel or Tremere domitor.
classicGhoul.independentDisciplines: An independent ghoul may take any Discipline (not Protean or Thaumaturgy); your Storyteller may ask for Celerity, Fortitude or Potence.
classicGhoul.backgroundsHint: Domitor (vassals only, optional): your master cares what becomes of you; its generation sets the dots (11th or higher: 1 … 6th: 5). No Generation, Herd or Status; Mentor mostly for independents; domitors seldom allow Retainers.
classicGhoul.poolHint: A ghoul holds up to 10 points of vitae and spends 1 per turn: to heal, to raise a Physical Attribute (up to twice the original), to use its Disciplines (they need at least 1 point). It starts with a roll of 1d10; an independent ghoul halves it, rounding up.
classicGhoul.title: Ghoul forge · Classic (Revised)
classicGhoul.noDomitor: A Classic ghoul belongs to one of your Classic vampires, and you have none yet. Forge the vampire first.
classicGhoul.created: {{name}} serves {{domitor}}. The sheet is on your Profile.
classicGhoul.intro: A ghoul by Ghouls: Fatal Addiction (Revised p. 276 points to it): a mortal kept on a vampire’s vitae. Place your creation dots, then spend 21 freebie points. It has no chronicle of its own: it goes where its domitor goes. Your Storyteller has the final say.
classicGhoul.identitySub: Whose ghoul, what kind, and who it is.
classicGhoul.kindIndependent: Independent: no master, finds vitae on its own
classicGhoul.dutiesPlaceholder: what the domitor has it do
classicGhoul.attributesSub: Every attribute starts at 1. Add 6 / 4 / 3 dots across Physical, Social, Mental.
classicGhoul.abilitiesSub: 11 / 7 / 4 across Talents, Skills, Knowledges; no ability above 3 before freebies.
classicGhoul.advantagesSub: Potence and one more Discipline, 5 Background dots, Virtues 1 free each + 7, and the Blood Pool.
classicGhoul.bondSub: Drinks of the domitor’s vitae: the third binds.
classicGhoul.bondHint: A vassal begins play Blood Bound to its domitor (3 drinks); an independent ghoul starts with none. Your Storyteller has the last word.
classicGhoul.lastFed: Last fed on the domitor's vitae
classicGhoul.overdosingHint: Overdosing: a ghoul can force down one extra point per dot of Stamina (a Stamina roll, difficulty 8), at a price (Fatal Addiction).
classicGhoul.backgroundPlaceholder: How the domitor found you, what you do for it, what you would do for the next drink…
classicGhoul.meritsHint: Fatal Addiction recommends some Vampire Merits and Flaws for ghouls, bars others (no Kindred ties, Deep Sleeper, Eat Food, Light-Sensitive…) and adds its own. Flaws give up to 7 more freebie points.
classicGhoul.freebiesSub: 21 points (+ up to 7 from Flaws) to raise anything above the creation budgets; a Discipline dot costs 10.
